blocks.text: World-renowned rapper, singer, dancer, and style icon, LISA releases her highly anticipated EP PRESS PLAY via LLOUD Co./RCA Records – Listen HERE. The six-track project is created with a movie in mind, so fans can sit down, and ‘press play.’ Alongside the EP, she releases the music video for focus track “Tarantino” – Watch HERE. The video follows LISA’s epic, action-packed journey through a hotel to deliver a note to her favorite director, Tarantino. In true Tarantino fashion, the video incorporates action sequences with LISA throwing punches at anyone who gets in her way. PRESS PLAY includes the previously released single […]...
